MetaCategoryTableEntity.description_en: The data table information item under the category of the attributable asset
MetaCategoryTableEntity.description_zh: 归属资产类目下的数据表信息项

CatalogName.description_en: For PostgreSQL-compatible databases, specify the database name

DatabaseSearchName.description_en: The name that is used to search for the database

DbId.description_en:
The database ID. You can call the [ListDatabases]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html） operation to query the ID of a physical database and the [ListLogicDatabases]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html） operation to query the ID of a logical database.

The value of DatabaseId is that of DbId
DbId.description_zh:
数据库ID，可通过调用接口[ListDatabases]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html）获取物理库ID的值，调用接口[ListLogicDatabases]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html）获取逻辑库ID的值。
DatabaseId的值即为DbId的值

DbType.description_en:
The type of the database. Valid values include but are not limited to:

MySQL
SQLServer
PostgreSQL
Oracle
DRDS
OceanBase
Mongo
Redis
DbType.description_zh:
数据库类型，取值包含但不限于：
MySQL
SQLServer
PostgreSQL
Oracle
DRDS
OceanBase
Mongo
Redis

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the [ListInstances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html） or [GetInstance]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html） operation to query the instance ID
InstanceId.description_zh: 实例ID。您可调用[ListInstances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html）或[GetInstance]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html）接口获取该参数的值

SchemaName.description_en:
Database name (for PostgreSQL-compatible databases, specify the schema name). You can call the [SearchDatabase]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html） operation to query the name of the database.

You can also call the [ListDatabases]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html） operation to query the SchemaName of a physical database or call the [ListLogicDatabases]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html） operation to query the SchemaName of a logical database
SchemaName.description_zh:
数据库名（PG系为模式名），可通过调用接口[SearchDatabase]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html）获取该参数的值。
您也可以通过调用接口[ListDatabases]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html）获取物理库的SchemaName值，调用接口[ListLogicDatabases]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html）获取逻辑库的SchemaName值

TableSchemaName.description_en: The schema name of the table, which is required only for SQL Server instances
TableSchemaName.description_zh: 表模式名，仅当SQLServer为架构名
